scripts.push: ELEVENTY_ENV=production eleventy && BASE_DIR=_prod npm run diff
scripts.diff: TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/site.XXXXXX) ; eleventy --output $TMP_DIR >/dev/null; echo ; echo $(tput smul bold setaf 5) diffing $TMP_DIR and $BASE_DIR:$(tput sgr0) ; echo ; diff -r $BASE_DIR $TMP_DIR ; echo ; echo $(tput smul bold setaf 5) done!$(tput sgr0) ; echo
